topic: 3 early warning signs of Vitamin D deficiency in adults
hook: 3 early warning signs of Vitamin D deficiency that adults often ignore
caption:
Meeru roju entha nidrapoyina alasataga untundha? 😴 Bone pains, excess hair fall, and frequent cold infections mindha dhyanam pettandi! Vitamin D mana body ki calcium absorb cheskovadaniki chala avasaram. Daily morning 15 mins soft sunlight lo undatam valla Vitamin D deficiency nundi kapadukovachu. ✨

poster_caption:
Are you feeling constantly exhausted or dealing with stubborn muscle stiffness?

Over 1 billion people worldwide suffer from insufficient Vitamin D levels without even knowing it.

Here are 3 key warning signs to watch out for:

01. Unexplained Bone & Joint Aches
02. Chronic Daytime Fatigue
03. Frequent Immune Breakdown

☀️ Golden Rule: Pair your D3 with healthy fats (avocado, eggs, olive oil) to maximize absorption!
